_comment: AF7c: schema.org types that are genuinely deprecated or superseded.
Was hardcoded in schema_typing.py as {'Breadcrumb'} with a source comment
admitting it was 'not actually deprecated, but example'. Matching is exact,
so the real BreadcrumbList (on 156 pages of one customer site) never
triggered it and nothing in the wild emits a bare 'Breadcrumb' — the check
was a placeholder that could only fire on a type that does not exist.
Empty is honest: an empty list means the check reports nothing, rather
than reporting something false. Add entries only with a citation.
